purpose: Teach: 市中/汝/減退/ゴシップ/小声/快挙/真田/悪戯

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市中、つまり市中相場の動向を毎朝確認しろ
lines.en: Every morning, check the movement of the open-market rates. Without fail.
lines.style: Clipped authoritative opening, no warm-up. Even command pace, each word landing squarely, flat final consonant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。「汝、お客様を大事にせよ」と社訓に追加します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll add 'Thou shalt hold the customer dear' to the company precepts.
lines.style: Quick crisp acknowledgment, then careful recitation of the quote. Methodical pace, mock-solemn formality stiffening the archaic phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業績減退の兆候を早めに把握しろ
lines.en: Get a grip on any sign of declining performance — early.
lines.style: Low controlled urgency. Measured pace, weight pressed onto the word early, unadorned declarative finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内ゴシップを抑制する制度を整えます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll put a system in place to keep office gossip in check.
lines.style: Prompt compliant reply, businesslike. Brisk even pace, a small conscientious stress on the new system.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、会議では小声、つまり小声でも明瞭に話せ
lines.en: In meetings, even at a whisper, speak clearly.
lines.style: Quieter but firmer, modeling the instruction itself. Slow deliberate pace, precise clipped articulation throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の快挙を表彰式で讃えます
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll celebrate our employees' finest feats at the awards ceremony.
lines.style: Brighter note of genuine enthusiasm breaking through. Upbeat pace, warmth lifting the ceremony mention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、戦略アドバイザーの真田様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Seek the counsel of Mr. Sanada, our strategy advisor.
lines.style: Respect entering the register for the advisor's name. Measured pace, formal weight resting on the honorific.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内の悪戯、つまり悪戯防止研修を実施します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll run training on preventing pranks and mischief in the office.
lines.style: Efficient closing acknowledgment, faint amusement suppressed. Steady pace, dutiful firm landing on the final verb.
